phase: Phase F2n - why PAD 103 2009-263 10:50-11:20 UTC Doppler scatters 69 mm/s (diagnostic, no gate)
written: 2026-10-28, after F2m (2a8f799) and before any F2n number. Known beforehand: the pass's UTDF mode/flags/stations match clean passes; it is 30 min long with one 470 s gap; the preceding PAD 103 pass (08:57-09:50) has flags 9 and its Doppler fails the F2e A1 bound
orbit: LOLA reference ephemeris (F2l), so the result does not depend on our estimate; F2k's Doppler bias
passes: the bad pass, and as controls the PAD 103 07:04-07:54 pass on 263 and the PAD 103 pass of the same local geometry on 262 (the third PAD 103 pass of that day)

steps.D1_residual_series: counted-Doppler residual per 5 s interval vs time; lag-1 autocorrelation; fraction with |r| > 20 mm/s; statistics before and after the 470 s gap; figure
steps.D2_raw_counts: per record: time-tag spacing, the UTDF microseconds field, count increment dN, count rate dN/dt; the observed rate minus the rate implied by the LOLA-computed Doppler, per interval

hypotheses.H_TIME: time-tag error: lag-1 autocorrelation < -0.3 (an error in one tag moves two adjacent intervals in opposite directions), or the microseconds field / tag spacing varies in the bad pass but not in the controls
hypotheses.H_SEGMENT: a contaminated stretch: >= 80 % of the |r| > 20 mm/s intervals lie in one contiguous segment (before or after the gap) while the rest of the pass is at the control level
hypotheses.H_NOISE: broadband degradation: |lag-1 autocorrelation| < 0.3, large residuals spread over the pass, no tag anomaly
hypotheses.otherwise: UNEXPLAINED; the hypotheses are not exclusive and are reported as computed

scale: for reference, a 1 microsecond error in one count time tag changes a 5 s interval's Doppler by about 3 mm/s (count rate ~2.4e8 Hz bias-dominated)
not_changed: no production code; F2k, F2l and F2m results are not changed; the F2m screening stays as declared
